title: Green Chili Soup
ingredients: 4 Roasted Chicken from grocery store: boned, skinned and shredded (TIP: Flip the clear lid from the chicken container over to put in the bones, skin, etc. Also, use two separate paper plates... one to put the shredded chicken on and one to use/ work on while picking the chicken)
4 Small Cans Great Northern or White Navy Beans: Drained and Rinsed
2 Small Cans Dices Tomatoes (Italian, Mexican or Garlic...whatever): Drained but not rinsed.
2 Small Cans or 4 Large Can Green Enchilada Sauce
1 Jar (2802 - 320z or so) Salsa Verde (Green Salsa - Mild, Medium or Hot to your taste. I use mild or medium)
2 Small cans diced green chilies (the real small ones - 6-8 oz)
4 small can or container of Reduced Sodium Chicken Broth
instructions: Mix all above, except chicken broth into the crock pot. Actually, save a little of the Salsa Verde. *Add small amounts of chicken broth to thin, BUT NOT TO MUCH (thick is good here This is where the left-over Salsa Verde comes in. If you add to much chicken broth it can QUICKLY kill the flavor.
If you do, add a little more Salsa Verde. It may even be a good idea to buy an extra jar of Salsa Verde just in case, but at that point, add slowly. It's all about the taste that you Like.
Extras (to garnish each bowl, which I didn't do at Mom's):
- Instead of crackers, add crushed-up white corn chips.
- Add shredded Monterrey or Jalapeno Jack Cheese
- Garnish with some chopped cilantro or sliced green onion, maybe even a few sliced/ seeded Jalapenos if you dare
